report: Checked all 21 candidate lemmas end to end and the four added units the table is blind to (v1 'and', v8 'Yea', v12 second 'us', v14 'more and more'). No split found: every difference is licensed by the source or by the ASV's own choice.

הוּא Sp3mp: 'They/they' in vv5-6 beside 'They have'/'have they' in v7 is rule 43 read correctly — vv5-6 write a possessive לְ that takes the have, v7 writes none so the suffix takes have with its pronoun, headed on the pronoun. 'their' vs 'them' vs 'Their' is possessive vs object vs possessive by context.
לֹא: v7's asyndetic 'Neither' (no waw in the colon) beside v17's וְלֹא fused to Neither (rule 35) is two different source shapes, not one construction two ways.
בָּטַח vv9-11: 'trust thou' and 'trust ye' go to the verb where the pronoun follows it; v11's 'Ye' stands before the vocative יִרְאֵי and goes there (rule 36). Consistent.
The refrain 'He is their help and their shield' (vv9-11) is identical in all three verses: הוּא → He, copula on עֵזֶר discontinuous around 'their' (rules 20, 25).
v14 'more and more' left added with the verb taking 'increase' alone; the verse pass named the competing reading (keep it with יָסַף) and either is defensible. Not touched.

v13 עִם rendered by the correlative pair 'Both … and' headed on 'and' is read on rule 14's terms (the pair belongs to the one connective the ASV rendered by it, whatever its lemma). Defensible; no precedent shown for עִם, so no promotion.

BSB disagreements (6): v7 paragogic nun (rule 32), v13 two articles the ASV writes no 'the' for (rule 29), v14 three עַל left bare before 'you'/'You'/'your children' (rule 40). All convention differences; none is an error.
No conventions recorded: the repeated notes are terse rule citations, and nothing chapter-wide goes beyond the contract. No promotions or amendments.
